Rae: Quick heads up — opened a small docs PR to update SDK streaming/pagination snippets to the generator/iterator style. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999

docs-bot: PR 4999 opened by Rae — title: 'samples: migration to async generator / iterator for streaming'

Jun: Nice. Can we make TS use `for await (const chunk of stream)` instead of callbacks? Less boilerplate.

Asha: Also for Python let's show a minimal async generator + tiny exponential+jitter backoff helper, 6-8 lines max. Avoid named TransientError — use a short comment instead.

Luca: I'll handle Go: prefer a channel + context pattern so it's idiomatic. Small sample only.

Rae: Checklist: 1) TS -> for-await 2) Py -> async generator + with_backoff 3) Go -> chan + ctx 4) add one-line pagination migration note (next_cursor in body) 5) fix streaming overview link

Jun: TS snippet I propose:
```ts
const s = client.asyncGenerate({prompt:'hi'})
for await (const p of s) console.log(p.text)
```

Asha: Compact Python backoff/helper:
```python
async def with_backoff(gen, *a, **kw):
  for i in range(3):
    try:
      async for x in gen(*a, **kw): yield x; return
    except Exception: await asyncio.sleep(min(0.5*2**i,5)+random.random())
```

Luca: Go channel pattern (one-liner style):
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx,30*time.Second)
defer cancel()
ch := make(chan string)
go func(){ defer close(ch); for c := range client.AsyncGenerate(ctx,p){ ch<-c.Text }}()
for s := range ch { fmt.Print(s) }
```

Jun: Pagination migration note (1 line): `cursor = resp.get('next_cursor')` (py) / `resp.nextCursor` (go) / `resp.next_cursor` (ts).

Rae: I'll fix the stale link and run the docs preview. Please push your tiny edits to the branch by EOD so I can merge tomorrow. Ping when pushed. :pray:
